title: Keep up the good work (yes, you)!!
author: Friend135
selftext:
Just wanted to give some encouragement to all the solo devs using AI out there!  There is so much negativity around what we’re doing, all because a few bad eggs are trying to copy other people’s work without any passion or care.  I know there are devs working really hard to bring their dreams to life with the help of AI, and I really hope that the general public becomes more accepting of this as time goes on.  

I’m currently using Opus 5.5 in Godot, and it has literally changed my life.  Dreams that were once relegated to the cabinet drawer are now real contenders for being developed and released.  The only real obstacle seems to be the negativity surrounding AI game dev as a whole.

So, just keep on doing you and I hope the best for all of your projects!  Feel free to let me know what you’re working on! :)

comments.author: fighthonor
comments.body: The general public doesn't care. It's only the loud minority anti ai crowd you're hearing from. Just forget them and keep going. You're not building your game for them anyway.

comments.author: gay_married
comments.body:
anti-AI art is anti-creativity, anti-indie, classist, ableist B U L L S H I T.

It is also a completely doomed movement that will only continue to fade in importance and prominence. I'm not even sure it's worth arguing with them. They are going to lose.

replies.author: Friend135
replies.body: Anyone who is anti-AI in game dev CLEARLY has never had a good idea!  Otherwise they’d be too busy working on it!

comments.author: Speccy_G
comments.body:
I work full-time in accounting, which means spending most of my workday staring at screens and having to stay focused. Back during my university days, I was really passionate about modding games, but over time, the repetitive and tedious aspects of game development slowly killed that enthusiasm.

Then I started experimenting with Claude Code earlier this year, and I’ve been blown away by its potential. It gave me a way back into a hobby I thought I’d left behind, and somehow I ended up shipping both a game and an app in 2026.

Now comes the shitty part: actually selling them.

replies.author: Friend135
replies.body: Congrats on shipping!!  That’s no small task even with AI.  I wish the best for you and your projects!

replies.author: Speccy_G
replies.body: Many thanks! Best of luck to you too!

comments.author: Turbulent-Camp-3368
comments.body: Isn't Opus like insane expensive? Currently I'm using the basic paid ChatGPT plan and what it does amazes me, but I wonder if there are others that are even more amazing.

replies.author: CinematicMusician
replies.body: Opus is a little on the expensive side for the Pro plan I found out after a week of using it, it also frequently did more steps than i wanted it to do. A "real" dev friend of mine suggested Sonnet on high or xhigh effort and just the high setting feels almost the same to me but takes a less tokens in general. I might still switch to Opus for the art stuff... I'll see when I get there.

comments.author: IsDaouda_Games
comments.body: One thing is certain: those who oppose AI will not stop people who are achieving good things with it. Because love is always stronger than hate.

comments.author: Significant-Trick923
comments.body: At the end of the day, what matters is the effort and creativity you put into making something you enjoy. Using AI doesn't make your ideas or hard work any less meaningful. Every developer has their own way of bringing ideas to life. There will always be criticism, but don't let it stop you from creating.

comments.author: Emergency_Mastodon56
comments.body: To you as well! Realize those dreams :)

comments.author: bimbimejia93
comments.body: Thank you!! Things will change soon with regards to AI keep learning and putting in the work!

comments.author: Lord_Forwind
comments.body: Thanks for the encouragement! I have released one game and working on others .

comments.author: anotherbuilddev
comments.body: Nice post OP, thanks and same to you

comments.author: Daikooku
comments.body: Laissons ces gens de côté avec leur négativité et fonçons ! Bon courage à tous !

comments.author: FlightFit335
comments.body:
Wait is this redditt?  Where am I?

Agree.  Refreshing post.  Don't stop creating.

comments.author: fakezii
comments.body:
I am using AI for my first game I am working on and I learned basic programming skills, but in no way I can make a game with it. But sometimes, and hear me out here please. I do understand the hate on AI slop. Having AI makes our dream of making games true! But our job should be creativity, asking AI to the be the creative brain is where I think the Hate on AI comes from. Worked with different AI models throughout, no matter what model you use, they always hallucinate. 

Don’t worry about AI haters, people will enjoy a good game regardless. Keep working guys

comments.author: Siemours
comments.body:
To you as well! Using AI to try and make a tactical RPG (after hitting some limitations on previous project in terms of sprite animation). 

Keep on the good work everyone, let all our projects end up as we envisioned them!

comments.author: Only_Pomegranate3992
comments.body:
To you as well!

I’m close to launching my first mobile game to android and iOS without forced ads and reasonable in-app purchases.

I used Opus 5.5 to work in Blender and Unity and I myself am really satisfied with the results after a couple of months working on it.

Once people start using AI correctly and you get high quality stuff it will be accepted, I’m sure of that (although you always have haters).
